schema.file: data/models/pnn/latent_<h>.parquet, h in {1h, 1d}; one row per walk-forward test step (out of sample)

columns.ts: decision time UTC (1h: bar open; 1d: 00:00 UTC of the forecast day D+1)
columns.refit_month: YYYY-MM of the walk-forward refit that produced the row (latent coordinates are per refit)
columns.ret: realised log return over the horizon (label; known only after ts + horizon)
columns.sigma_ref: point-in-time scale (1h sqrt(robust_bc s2); 1d exp(lrv_w / 2)); quantiles / sigma_ref = model units
columns.z0..z3: latent (bottleneck) state of the seed-0 PNN of that refit, raw scale
columns.zhat0..zhat3: predicted next latent A z + B u + c (H-PNN3 dynamics), raw scale
columns.zf0..zf3, zfhat0..zfhat3: latent / predicted next latent under the LATEST refit network for every row (one fixed coordinate system for plotting; rows before that refit's training cut are in-sample for it)
columns.aci_lo80/aci_hi80, ..90, ..95: adaptive conformal band (Gibbs-Candes) around the PNN, return units
columns.sc_lo80/sc_hi80, ..90, ..95: split-conformal band (calibration = refit validation block), return units
columns.aci_alpha80, aci_alpha90, aci_alpha95: ACI running miscoverage level alpha_t used for the row

schema.frozen: data/models/pnn/frozen_<h>.json: latest refit KAN (enc/head coef [out,in,deg] for Chebyshev T1..T4 of tanh(0.5 x), w_res for silu(x), bias), standardiser mu/sd, clip, feature names, dynamics A/B/c/zmu/zsd, taus
